_readme: Companies that hire interns/freshers in India. `npm run discover` (also run automatically once a week) opens each careers page, detects which hiring system it uses (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, SmartRecruiters, Workday) and adds it to discovered.json. Companies whose careers site can't be read automatically are listed under Programs → 'Check these careers pages directly'. Add any company here: { "name": ..., "careers": ..., "domain": ... }.
